CustomField.label: Has Violations
CustomField.description: Stamped by the Universal Budget package (#47): true while any budget, category or period limit is breached, or money sits in a period outside the budget's dates. Mapped as the Budget Has Violations Field. The package writes it; enforcement (validation rules, Flows, approvals) is yours.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shown when something in this budget is outside its limits. Open the budget to see what needs attention.
